caption:
Six rules dictate when your terminal locks.

Configure your parameters before open. KaatDo runs server-side evaluations against six specific rules: max_daily_loss, profit_target, max_trades, kill_time, kill_days, and kill_dates.

Rules are locked during market hours. On breach, KaatDo cancels every pending order, squares off every position at market, and keeps the account locked until close. If new trading activity reappears, the switch re-fires.

Every evaluation and broker call is stored in a full audit log, with Telegram alerts, webhook and email notifications.
